scientific_question: Can one fixed, observation-budgeted classical H1 Tikhonov rule make the five-, seven-, and nine-camera 24x24 calibrated proxy references simultaneously adequate without using field truth for regularization selection?
role: post-open private controlled proxy development; not a learned method and not real experimental pairing

inputs.model_calibration_pairing: complete 9 x 13 cross-product; never infer a true match
inputs.field_preprocessing: subtract global mean, then divide by global RMS

representation.transform: orthonormal three-dimensional DCT-II coefficients with inverse DCT-III lift
representation.penalty: physical-axis Neumann H1 spectral eigenvalue, normalized to median one over active coefficients
representation.penalty_floor: none; removing the constant mode makes every registered penalty weight positive

regularization.geometry_scale: median generalized normal eigenvalue above max-eigenvalue times 1e-12
regularization.selection: choose the largest registered lambda multiplier whose exact reduced residual norm divided by observation norm is at most 0.18; if none is feasible choose multiplier 0.0
regularization.tie_break: largest lambda multiplier, then roster order
regularization.truth_use: post-hoc field and gradient scoring only

arms.fixed_diagnostic_roster: one row for every frozen lambda multiplier; never substitute one as the primary after results

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration; camera subsets reuse sealed rows
cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: one exact reduced A-transpose equivalent for B^T y and one exact reduced A equivalent for the selected projection
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a future fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by arm and camera count

independent_recomputation.camera_ray_construction: direct from raw R,t with order-3 Gauss-Legendre quadrature
independent_recomputation.dct_basis: standalone analytic orthonormal cosine products; do not call formal basis builder
independent_recomputation.reduced_operator: standalone column-by-column exact forward actions; do not call formal sparse matrix product
independent_recomputation.solver: standalone symmetric generalized eigensolve and standalone normal-equation CG control

decision_order: Any input, operator, basis, penalty, stationarity, parent-control, residual, accounting, or independent-recomputation failure makes v158 inconclusive.
Only the preregistered Budget0.18 primary determines the scientific pass; fixed-lambda rows are diagnostics and cannot replace it after results.

The primary passes only if five, seven, and nine cameras all satisfy every frozen field, gradient, and observation gate and the nine-camera field and gradient p90 values do not worsen by more than one percent relative to the v157 parent control.

A valid primary failure closes this private variable-cardinality warm-predictor route pending richer three-dimensional fields or paired experimental two-dimensional measurements; no larger model or GPU rescue is allowed.
A valid primary pass only authorizes a separately frozen minimal shared-parameter CPU predictor; it is not itself learned, a resource result, external generalization, or real BOST.
